empty_program_probe.detail: Even an empty C program times out before main under this AddressSanitizer runtime.
empty_program_probe.scope: Optional local memory-checker startup probe; not a DSP failure or a passing sanitizer run.

scope: Local Apple Clang 17/macOS runtime initialization deadlock was observed by sampling the stalled two-block process. This is not evidence of an engine failure or a passing AddressSanitizer test. The unrelated completed undefined/bounds/float-cast suite remains valid.
